fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2025-03-24, around 22:45, the complainant parked a grey motorcycle bearing registration number TN-68-YY-1058 at Mullai Puram Parking Area in Thanjavur and found it missing on return, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-03-24. The complaint mentions Abirami Krishnan, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000111, in connection with the events. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage and a vehicle observation.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle reportedly taken during the night from a residential parking spot.
fields.Keywords: motorcycle theft, vehicle, mobile number, suspect, vehicle observation, CCTV, motorcycle, parking area
